assets.name: xoltacan-panel-paleta
assets.prompt: Edit the attached texture, preserving its wide aspect ratio, composition, border motifs, material grain, engraved relief, and quiet central space for overlaid text. This is a color-palette correction, not a new layout. No added text, UI, characters, or objects. Keep intricate craftsmanship, rich detail and readable dark center. No rainbow accents. The authoritative Xoltacan palette is #050A0B #20292B #373B35 #4D5335 #6A6F41 #838A49 #3D6779 #537989 #6791A9 #9ABAC7 #B3D2D3 #CEB398 #ECCFAC #F7EAC8 #E9E626 #F52024. Replace the emerald/jade and saturated turquoise stone with charcoal #20292B and smoky gray stone #373B35, olive moss #4D5335 #6A6F41 #838A49. Leaf relief should be olive, not emerald. Use slate blue mineral veins #3D6779 #537989 #6791A9 with tiny pale blue highlights #9ABAC7. Replace metallic gold and bronze framing with carved limestone and weathered stone in #CEB398 #ECCFAC, subdued #F7EAC8 edge highlights. Strong yellow #E9E626 and red #F52024 may appear ONLY as extremely small inset pigment details at the outer corners, not luminous large shapes or colored borders. Dominant impression: shadowy olive tropical vegetation, dark stone and pale limestone; subtle cool sky-blue veins. Eliminate green emerald, teal jade, shiny gold and copper hues outside this palette. Use the palette as the exclusive color family with natural shading.
